# Formats

Print and social formats are pages at a fixed size, captured to PDF or PNG (D-005, D-043). They mirror the Figma templates; the art is a placeholder until the art direction is in (D-035). Content here is placeholder text (COMP-004).

| Format | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| [Flyer, Letter](flyer.html) | 612×792pt | `gg-flyer` |
| [Postcard, front](postcard-front.html) | 306×396pt | `gg-postcard` |
| [Postcard, back](postcard-back.html) | 306×396pt | `gg-postcard` |
| [Postcard, sheet of four](postcard-sheet.html) | 612×792pt | `gg-postcard-sheet` |
| [Social, feed](social-feed.html) | 1080×1350px | `gg-social`, size: feed |
| [Social, story](social-story.html) | 1080×1920px | `gg-social`, size: story |
| [Social, event cover](social-cover.html) | 1920×1005px | `gg-social`, size: cover |

Print pages show 1px as 1pt (D-034): print them at 100% on Letter paper with no margins.
